opening.b01_new_game.title: Arrival at Duel Academy

commands.title: OBJECTIVE
commands.subtitle: Attend the opening assembly in the Duel Gym

opening.b01_new_game.notes: Port-original arrival framing. The GBA opens directly with Sheppard's gym speech.

opening.b02_sheppard_speech.title: Sheppard's Opening Speech
opening.b02_sheppard_speech.notes: Canon beat: Sheppard's speech in the gym. Prose is port-original.

opening.b03_registration.title: Registration with Mimicry
opening.b03_registration.notes: Canon beat: registration with Mimicry. Name entry follows the GBA manual's eight-letter limit.

opening.b03_name_entry.title: Name Entry

input.note: GBA manual: the player may enter a name of up to eight letters; END confirms.

opening.b03_name_entry.notes: Text entry is modeled as a Choice command with input metadata, keeping the 13-command enum intact.

opening.b03_name_accepted.title: Registration Complete
opening.b03_name_accepted.notes: Registration complete; the shop opening is announced for next Saturday (October 7). The starter-deck choice happens in new-game setup.

opening.b04_dorm_welcome.title: Slifer Red Dorm Welcome

commands.title: SLIFER RED DORM
commands.subtitle: West Cliff - Home of the Red

opening.b04_dorm_welcome.notes: Canon beat: meet Banner, Jaden, Syrus and Chumley at the Slifer Red dorm.

opening.b05_banner_dp.title: Banner's 3,000 DP and the Card Shop
opening.b05_banner_dp.notes: Canon beat: Banner grants 3,000 DP and explains DP and the card shop. Email contacts unlock here.

opening.b06_tutorial.title: Syrus's Duel Tutorial
opening.b06_tutorial.notes: Teaches deck size, LP, summon/set/tribute, battle positions, spells/traps and win conditions.

opening.b06_tutorial_phases.title: Tutorial - Phases
opening.b06_tutorial_phases.notes: Optional rules refresher loop; returns to the tutorial prompt.

opening.b06_tutorial_duel.title: Tutorial Duel - Practice Match
opening.b06_tutorial_duel.notes: Practice duel only: no DP, no win counter, loss does not block progression. Uses A07's syrus_roids deck in free mode with tutorial metadata.

opening.b06_tutorial_win.title: Tutorial Duel - Won
opening.b06_tutorial_win.notes: Completes E01. Event outcomes advance the calendar to Saturday, October 7 AM.

opening.b06_tutorial_lose.title: Tutorial Duel - Lost
opening.b06_tutorial_lose.notes: Loss is a valid tutorial outcome. The player may retry or continue; neither blocks the story.

opening.b06_tutorial_continue.title: Tutorial - Continue After Loss
opening.b06_tutorial_continue.notes: Completes E01 after a practice loss. No penalty, no softlock.

opening.b07_first_free_roam.title: First Free-Roam Day
opening.b07_first_free_roam.notes: The card shop announced for 'next Saturday' is open today. Manual save unlocks here.

opening.b07_save.title: Save Prompt
opening.b07_save.notes: Demonstrates the PDA save flow. A02 owns the actual slot write.

opening.b07_free_roam.title: Free Roam Begins
opening.b07_free_roam.notes: E01b completes here. The player regains control; Jaden's optional duel is available outside.

opening.b08_jaden_intro.title: Optional Jaden Free Duel
opening.b08_jaden_intro.notes: Optional free duel, clearly separated from the Syrus tutorial. Declining leaves the event available.

opening.b08_jaden_decline.title: Jaden Duel - Declined
opening.b08_jaden_decline.notes: Decline path: do not complete FJ01. The player can talk to Jaden again.

opening.b08_jaden_duel_setup.title: Jaden Duel - Setup
opening.b08_jaden_duel_setup.notes: Free duel mode. Loss is a valid outcome; no story gate, no forced retry.

opening.b08_jaden_win.title: Jaden Duel - Won
opening.b08_jaden_win.notes: Win path. A02 awards DP from the duel result formula; event outcomes add wins/duels counters.

opening.b08_jaden_lose.title: Jaden Duel - Lost
opening.b08_jaden_lose.notes: Loss path. The event completes; Jaden remains available for repeatable free duels.
